_source: Gathala et al. 2011 SSSAJ 75:1851-1862 (scanned 300 ppi). Manual readings on 2-4x zoomed crops with calibrated gridlines overlaid (axis ticks located in the bitmap).

fig2_aggregate_classes_pct._note: Water-stable aggregate size distribution after 7 cycles (2008-09 wheat harvest), % of soil, 0-15 cm. y: 0 % at px 924.5, 25.54 px per %. Precision about +/-0.5 % (6 overlapping series); classes 2-4 of T3-T6 overlap ('ns'/'a') and are read from the series lines. Sum of classes >0.25 mm reproduces Table 3 2008-09 within ~1 %.

fig3_soil_temp_5cm._note: Weekly mean soil temperature (deg C) at 5 cm, wheat seasons 2006-07 to 2008-09 averaged; only T1, T3, T5 plotted. Morning y: 17 C at px 1544, 53.25 px/C; afternoon: 28 C at px 2235, 33.4 px/C; week 1 at x 772, 56 px/week. +/-0.15 C; where T1 and T3 coincide both get the common value.

fig5_LLWR_pct_vv._note: Least-limiting water range, 2008-09 wheat season, bars measured on the scan (0 at px 419, 67.8 px per unit on the 2x crop). T5 0-5 cm bar top is cut by the crop - text value 6.2 used; text values T2 3.0/3.1 and T5 6.2/5.8 reproduced.
